items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: trombone player was the leader, Mister Mori. Tōru Mori. I was hired because I played like Matsui-san

ctx.x: It was a quintet [chuckles]. And, uh, I would sit next to him and I watched him play. I remember when I tried to play like that, I said, “Very soon, I will play like Matsui-san,” and Matsui-san was the leader and so I got a job with this trombone player who had a band, in another department [store], called Isetan—it‟s still there, though, in Shinjuku, up there. There was a … this was for American people, and trombone player was the leader, Mister Mori. Tōru Mori. I was hired because I played like Matsui-san
